verdict.rationale: Agora's own Conversational AI and real-time speech-to-text offerings claim to route live channel audio to a chosen ASR and LLM, and to add live captions and transcripts during calls and streams. This is the core of the story, but the evidence is marketing-level only. The raw audio frame observer is a developer building block and is not credited. Missing for 10: documentation of configuring an arbitrary transcription or realtime-model endpoint, explicit live-audio streaming mechanics and latency details, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, live session audio can be streamed to a transcription or realtime model endpoint while the session is running

citations.quote: Integrate any LLM or existing AI agent with your choice of ASR and TTS, to enable real-time voice conversations
Add live captions to calls and streams, generate transcripts, and integrate with large language models (LLMs).
Captions, speech understanding, and multilingual live experiences.
